descriptions.normal: A traditional Liyue snack. The flavor of the tea seeps into the egg through cracks in its shell while it is boiling, and the cracks are as beautiful as the fractured patterns of jade.
descriptions.suspicious: A traditional Liyue snack. It tastes no different from a standard boiled egg. Did something go wrong with the tea leaves or the cooking process?
descriptions.delicious: A traditional Liyue snack. The aroma of tea finds itself perfectly blended into the eggs. A dollop of deliciousness whether eaten all in one go or savored in small nibbles.

effectTexts.normal: Revives a character and restores 100 HP.
effectTexts.suspicious: Revives a character and restores 50 HP.
effectTexts.delicious: Revives a character and restores 150 HP.
